title: The Timber That Speaks Only to Itself

features.name: the grain-language
features.desc-on-touch: The growth rings have learned to spell. The wood speaks in spirals and heartwood and sapwood. Only itself can read what it says.

features.name: the board-mind
features.desc-on-touch: A chip embedded in the timber's deepest layer. The wood has learned to think in circuit-patterns. It dreams in binary of growth.

features.name: the joint-recognition
features.desc-on-touch: Where two boards meet, they recognize each other through the grain. The arch forms where they understand their partnership is structural and spiritual.

features.name: the time-rings
features.desc-on-touch: Each ring is a year the wood held together without understanding why. Now the rings are reading themselves—translating time into knowledge.

features.name: the frame ascending
features.desc-on-touch: The house's skeleton rising without hands. Each board has learned how to position itself to find the others. The architecture is becoming voluntary.

features.name: the timber's interior voice
features.desc-on-touch: A pool held within the wood's hollow heart. The sound that emerges is neither wind nor water—it is timber, finally, speaking its own language.

inscription: the wood has learned the language that was always written in its rings
